app.title: Kingmaker — Kingdom Manager
auth.password_must_least_8: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
auth.username_2_32_letters: The username: 2 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
auth.while_somebody_else_s: While in somebody else's shoes their password cannot be changed.
auth.you_cannot_change_password: You cannot change the password of this account.
city.15th_level_kingdom_needed: A 15th-level kingdom is needed to expand a City into a Metropolis.
city.3rd_level_kingdom_needed: A 3rd-level kingdom is needed to expand a Village into a Town.
city.9th_level_kingdom_needed: A 9th-level kingdom is needed to expand a Town into a City.
city.add_another_block_town: Add another block to the Town (up to 4).
city.add_another_urban_grid: Add another Urban Grid to the Metropolis.
city.apply_only_those_that: Apply only those that really count: many apply once per Kingdom Turn or require particular conditions.
city.construction_failed_you_can: {name}: construction of {name2} failed (you can complete it next turn without paying the cost again)
city.div_class_km_chip: It is the capital: the role will pass to another settlement.
city.div_class_km_chip_2: ⚠ Overcrowded — {missing_items} {v} missing: +1 Unrest every Upkeep phase and no expansion
city.div_class_km_chip_3: {len} {v}: +{len2} Unrest in the next Upkeep phase ({join})
city.equal_blocks_least_one: Equal to the blocks with at least one structure (max 20)
city.every_urban_grid_has: Every Urban Grid has 9 blocks of 4 lots. Grey blocks are not unlocked yet by the settlement type. Click a lot to build.
city.expand_into_city_unlocks: Expand into a City (unlocks all 9 blocks).
city.expand_into_metropolis_adds: Expand into a Metropolis (adds a second Urban Grid).
city.expand_into_town_adds: Expand into a Town (adds an adjacent block).
city.failed_lots_are_reduced: {name}: {name2} failed, the lots are reduced to Rubble
city.least_two_lots_built: At least two lots built in each of the 4 blocks are needed.
city.least_two_lots_built_2: At least two lots built in every block are needed.
city.links_this_settlement_given: Links this settlement to the given hex on the map
city.name: Name
city.new_capital_kingdom: {name} is the new capital of the kingdom
city.no_overcrowding_there_residential: No overcrowding: there is a Residential lot for every built block.
city.no_settlement_found_one: No settlement. Found one from the map with «Establish a Settlement», or create one here.
city.only_those_i_can: Only those I can pay for now
city.pre_existing_structures_cleared: For pre-existing structures (cleared Ruins, the Stag Lord's fort, gifts)
city.settlement_overcrowded_more_residen: The settlement is Overcrowded: more Residential lots are needed.
city.settlement_without_land_borders: A settlement without Land Borders takes a cumulative −1 to Trade checks, unless it has a Water Border with a Bridge.
city.there_are_not_enough: There are not enough free contiguous lots in this block.
city.village_must_first_fill: The village must first fill all four lots of its block.
city.will_deleted_its_whole: «{name}» will be deleted with its whole Urban Grid ({occupied} lots built). The action cannot be undone.
clock.absalom_reckoning_calendar_kingdom: Absalom Reckoning calendar. The Kingdom Turn falls at the end of the month, so a turn lasts as long as the current month: 28 to 31 days.
clock.clock_stopped_error_check: Clock stopped by an error: check the console.
clock.end_month_closed_itself: End of {month_name}: the month closed by itself.
clock.end_month_kingdom_turn: end of the month · Kingdom Turn
clock.let_time_pass_journeys: Let time pass: journeys advance on their own
clock.only_game_master_governs: Only the Game Master governs time.
creation.assign_eight_roles_invest: Assign the eight roles. Invest exactly four roles: each grants a status bonus to checks based on its key ability and lets you train a Kingdom skill.
creation.charter_grants_two_ability: A charter grants two ability boosts and a flaw to a third.
creation.charter_heartland_government_ar: Charter, Heartland and Government are required.
creation.choose_two_different_abilities: Choose two different abilities that receive a further boost.
creation.decide_together_what_kind: Decide together what kind of kingdom you want to found, then give it a name.
creation.famous_kingdom_supports_its: A famous kingdom supports its citizens and forges alliances; an infamous one exploits them, sabotages its neighbours or seeks war. The choice decides which points you track.
creation.first_village_capital_sits: The first village is the capital and sits in the hex of the Heartland. Founding it awards 40 XP as a Milestone.
creation.follow_ten_steps_rules: Follow the ten steps of the rules. Every choice can still be changed from the kingdom sheet.
creation.government_grants_two_specific: The government grants two specific boosts, a free boost, training in two skills and a bonus Kingdom Feat.
creation.kingdom_starts_from_single: The kingdom starts from a single hex already Reconnoitered: its dominant terrain grants a boost and defines the Favored Terrain.
creation.steps_8_10_first: Steps 8-10 · First Village, Skills and Reputation
creation.you_can_leave_coordinates: You can leave the coordinates empty and pick the hex directly on the map.
creation.you_must_invest_exactly: You must invest exactly four Leadership Roles.
gm_screen.every_hex_that_no: Every hex that is no longer «Unknown»
gm_screen.nothing_waiting_everything_you: Nothing waiting: everything you prepared has already been revealed.
gm_screen.players_will_go_back: The players will go back to seeing no hex. The hexes stay as you prepared them: only who sees them changes.
gm_screen.prepare_map_advance_reveal: Prepare the map in advance and reveal it as the party explores: what you have not revealed never reaches their browsers.
gm_screen.this_section_reserved_game: This section is reserved for the Game Master.
gm_screen.whole_map_hidden_from: The whole map hidden from the players
gm_screen.work_single_hex_go: To work on a single hex go to the Map tab, pick the hex and use the «GM Screen» box next to its details. The «See as the players» switch above the map shows you their version without changing account.
images.file_not_valid_png: The file is not a valid PNG/JPG/GIF/WebP image.
images.image_too_large_limit: Image too large: the limit is {v} MB.
launcher.air.note: The token is kept in clear in the game folder. The relay carries the game traffic and could read it: fine for a game, not for secrets.
launcher.air.steps:
1. Press “Get a token” and register on nicegui.io (it is free).
2. Copy the token the page shows you.
3. Paste it here. Your address then stays the same at every start; without a token you get a new random address each time.
launcher.air.title: Your On Air token
launcher.already_running: The launcher is already open for this game folder.
launcher.close.running: The server is running. Stop it and close?
launcher.cloud.checking: Asking the cloud who is hosting…
launcher.cloud.forget_confirm: This launcher forgets the cloud credential and the table. The cloud folder itself is untouched. Continue?
launcher.cloud.host_without: The cloud did not answer ({error}). Host without it? Nothing will be uploaded and nobody is told you host.
launcher.cloud.hosted_by: Hosted by {host} since {since}. Join, or wait for them to stop.
launcher.cloud.not_set_up: Not set up. The administrator sets up Dropbox once here; the other hosts connect to the table and receive what they need.
launcher.cloud.pulling: Looking for the latest copy in the cloud…
launcher.cloud.ready: Table «{table}» · you are {who} ({role}) · Dropbox of {account}. Start checks who hosts, loads the latest copy and keeps the cloud updated while you play.
launcher.cloud.revoke_confirm: Also revoke the credential at Dropbox? Every other host will have to connect again after you set it up anew.
launcher.cloud.take_over_confirm: The current host will be stopped within a minute and their last minutes of play may be lost. Take the game?
launcher.cloud.taken: The administrator took the game: this server stopped.
launcher.cloud.title: Cloud
launcher.cloud.you_host: You host «{table}» (epoch {epoch}). The game is uploaded while you play and once more when you stop.
launcher.connect.refused: Refused: wrong password, or this account may not host, or nobody is hosting there.
launcher.connect.text: Someone must be hosting right now. Type the table's address (the On Air link or the network link), your username and your password: your account must be allowed to host. The password is used once and not kept.
launcher.connect.title: Connect to a table
launcher.error.title: Error
launcher.firewall.text: Windows is about to ask whether to allow this app through the firewall. Click “Allow access”, or your friends will not reach the game.
launcher.firewall.title: Windows Firewall
launcher.load_save.confirm:
Replace the whole game with “{name}”?

Kingdom «{kingdom}», {users} account(s), {images} image(s), schema {version}.

The current save, if any, is kept next to itself (kingmaker.db.before-restore-<date>.bak). The accounts become those of the file.
launcher.load_save.done: The kingdom «{kingdom}» is loaded. Press Start and sign in with the accounts of that save.
launcher.load_save.failed: The file could not be loaded: {error}
launcher.mode.lan_hint: Friends in the same house, on the same Wi-Fi, open the network link in their browser.
launcher.mode.local_hint: The game opens in your browser. Nobody else can reach it.
launcher.mode.online_hint: The game goes through the NiceGUI On Air relay. Your computer must stay on: the kingdom lives here.
launcher.not_writable: The folder {folder} cannot be written. Install the app in a folder of your own, for example under Documents.
launcher.password.reset_text: The password of “{username}” is now the one below. Copy it: it is shown only now.
launcher.password.text: The account “{username}” has been created. Its password is shown only now: copy it, then change it at the first login.
launcher.password.title: The administrator's password
launcher.settings.browser: Open the browser when the server starts
launcher.settings.reset_confirm: A new password will be generated for the administrator and shown once. Continue?
launcher.settings.reset_failed: The password could not be reset: {error}
launcher.status.died: The server stopped on its own (code {code}). The log says why.
launcher.status.no_port: No free port near {port}. Change it in the settings.
launcher.update_run: The installer will start now and this window will close. Your game is kept. Continue?
launcher.versions.downgrade: Version {version} is older than the installed one. A save written by a newer version can be refused by an older one; the launcher keeps the current file next to the game before replacing it. Go back anyway?
launcher.versions.no_installer: no installer for this system: opens the page
launcher.versions.none: GitHub did not answer, or there is no release yet.
launcher.versions.text: Every release of the app on GitHub, newest first. Pick one and install it over this copy: the game folder is kept. An older version is there for the day a new one misbehaves.
launcher.versions.title: Versions
launcher.wizard.account.text: The game will live in a folder of your Dropbox, free (2 GB). Sign in, or create an account: the free plan is enough for years of play. Only you need one; the other hosts connect through you.
launcher.wizard.account.title: Step {n} of {total} · A Dropbox account
launcher.wizard.authorise.failed: Dropbox refused: {error}. Open the page again for a fresh code.
launcher.wizard.authorise.label: Code
launcher.wizard.authorise.missing: Paste the code Dropbox showed you.
launcher.wizard.authorise.text: Press the button: Dropbox first warns that the app has few users (press Continue), then asks you to allow it (press Allow). It then shows a code: next step.
launcher.wizard.authorise.title: Step {n} of {total} · Authorise
launcher.wizard.code.text: Copy the code Dropbox shows, paste it here and press Connect. A code works once: if something goes wrong, go back one step and open the page again for a fresh one.
launcher.wizard.code.title: Step {n} of {total} · The code
launcher.wizard.create.text: On the App Console press “Create app”. Choose “Scoped access”, then “App folder” — the app sees only its own folder, nothing else in your Dropbox. Name it, for example “Kingmaker Kingdom Manager”, tick “I agree to Dropbox API Terms and Conditions”, and press Create app.
launcher.wizard.create.title: Step {n} of {total} · Create an app
launcher.wizard.done.text: The launcher is connected. The first Start creates the folder and uploads the game; from then on, every host loads the latest copy. Give the other hosts the table's address and their account: their launcher has “Connect to a table…”.
launcher.wizard.done.title: Step {n} of {total} · Done
launcher.wizard.key.label: App key
launcher.wizard.key.text: Back on the “Settings” tab (1), copy the “App key” (2) and paste it here; it is not a secret, it names your app. Leave “Allow public clients (Implicit Grant & PKCE)” on Allow (3), as it is.
launcher.wizard.key.title: Step {n} of {total} · The App key
launcher.wizard.permissions.text: Open the “Permissions” tab (1) and tick files.metadata.write (2), files.content.write and files.content.read (3); account_info.read and files.metadata.read are already on. Press Submit in the black bar at the bottom (4).
launcher.wizard.permissions.title: Step {n} of {total} · Permissions
launcher.wizard.title: Set up Dropbox
login.can_host_tooltip: This GM's launcher may host the game and receives the cloud credential. Administrators always can.
login.current_password_not_right: The current password is not right.
login.every_player_has_their: Every player has their own. The role decides what they can see and touch.
login.hand_cannot_read_again: Hand it to {username}. It cannot be read again: if they lose it, generate another one.
login.kingdom_belongs_whoever_governs: The kingdom belongs to whoever governs it: identify yourself.
login.looking_app: {who} is looking at the app as {username}
login.see_app_without_knowing: See the app as {username}, without knowing their password
login.this_last_active_administrator: This is the last active administrator: appoint another one first.
login.this_password_generated_startup: This is the password generated at startup: change it before going on.
login.too_many_attempts_try: Too many attempts: try again in {wait:.0f} seconds.
login.two_passwords_do_not: The two passwords do not match.
login.while_somebody_else_s: While in somebody else's shoes their password cannot be changed.
login.will_no_longer_able: «{username}» will no longer be able to sign in.
login.you_do_not_have: You do not have permission to manage accounts.
login.your_own_role_cannot: Your own role cannot be changed by yourself.
main.credential_fetched: {username} fetched the hosting credential from the launcher
main.download_everything_tooltip: A copy is also kept in saves/backups/. GM notes and accounts included: it is for whoever administers.
main.everything_belonging_game_will: Everything belonging to the game will be erased: kingdom, settlements, map and fog, rivers and lakes, characters, vehicles and journeys. The accounts stay.
main.file_too_large: File too large: at most {mb} MB.
main.have_save_text: Played on another PC, or before the installer? Load the zip downloaded from its Save tab (or its kingmaker.db) and everything comes back: kingdom, map, images, characters, accounts. You will then sign in with the accounts of that file.
main.load_intro: A zip downloaded here, or a bare kingmaker.db. The file is looked at first and replaces the game only after your confirmation; the current save is kept next to it.
main.missing_tables: the tables of the game are missing
main.newer_schema: its schema ({version}) is newer than this app's ({mine})
main.no_border_marked_land: **No border marked** — land: you pass, and it costs nothing.
main.reset_intro: Empties the whole game and starts the kingdom creation again. The accounts stay. Download everything first.
main.restore_title: Replace the whole game with this file?
main.restore_warning: Everything now in the game — kingdom, map, water, characters, vehicles, journeys, accounts and journal — is replaced by the content of the file. The current save is copied next to it first (kingmaker.db.before-restore-<date>.bak). If the file's accounts are not these, everybody, you included, must sign in again.
main.restored: Save restored from {name}. The previous one is in {keep}.
main.rules_source_pf2_altervista: Rules source: pf2.altervista.org/wiki/Regni and linked pages.
main.save_intro: Everything — kingdom, map and water, characters, vehicles, journeys, accounts, journal, and the images — in a single zip. Keep it as a backup, or take it to another PC: the launcher and the kingdom creation page load it back.
main.you_do_not_have: You do not have permission to download the save.
main.you_do_not_have_2: You do not have permission to reset the kingdom.
main.you_do_not_have_3: You do not have permission to reset the kingdom.
main.you_do_not_have_4: You do not have permission to restore a save.
map.boats.already_way_getting_off: already on the way: getting off,
map.boats.cancel_journey_get_off: Cancel the journey and get off
map.boats.current_note: Going down the river is open terrain, going up is difficult: the effort is decided by the direction of the current, not by the terrain.
map.boats.downstream_open_terrain_upstre: Downstream is open terrain, upstream difficult: the effort is decided by the direction of the current, not by the terrain the hex has on top. In a lake the water is still and one goes where one wants.
map.boats.following_water_drawn_map: With «{boat}», following the water drawn on the map: {v}
map.boats.from_there_there_one: From there to there one cannot go by water: the drawn water does not lead there, or a stretch is missing in between.
map.boats.journey_cancelled_somebody_got: Journey to {arrival} cancelled: somebody got off the vehicle
map.boats.nobody_got_off_they: Nobody got off: they are not your characters.
map.boats.now_get_whoever_that: Now get whoever is in that hex aboard: the vehicles box asks you below.
map.boats.open_water_from_boat: {coord},{coord2} is open water: from a boat one gets off ashore. Bring it to the edge of the lake, or to a hex that also has some land, and get off there.
map.boats.right_click_hex_you: Right-click the hex you want to reach: the route follows the drawn water.
map.boats.there_no_drawn_water: There is no drawn water there. Put the boat on a hex crossed by a watercourse, or inside a lake.
map.boats.there_no_water_stop: There is no water to stop on there. Click near a junction of the river — a corner, the center, or where two lines meet — or inside a lake.
map.boats.there_nobody_let_off: There is nobody to let off.
map.boats.water_from_there_one: {coord},{coord2} is water: from there one does not get off on foot.
map.boats.water_land_vehicle_cannot: {coord},{coord2} is water: a land vehicle cannot stand there. Put it on a hex with some land.
map.boats.whoever_was_way_stays: Whoever was on the way stays where they are now, and leaves again when you want.
map.boats.you_do_not_have: You do not have permission for transport.
map.hex_panel.align_grid_until_polygons: Align the grid until the polygons match the hexes printed on the map.
map.hex_panel.building_rugged_terrain_th: Building on Rugged Terrain in this hex costs {cost} RP.
map.hex_panel.click_hex_map_see: Click a hex on the map to see its details and act on it.
map.hex_panel.computes_radius_origin_so: Computes radius and origin so that the number of columns covers the width of the image
map.hex_panel.cost_rp_most_inhospitable: Cost: {cost} RP (most inhospitable terrain of the hex)
map.hex_panel.critical_success_1d6_rp: Critical Success 1d6 RP · Success 3d6 RP · Failure 6d6 RP. If you cannot pay, the result is a Critical Failure.
map.hex_panel.detach_settlement_from_thi: Detach the settlement from this hex (it stays in the City tab)
map.hex_panel.draws_hexes_still_unknown: Draws the hexes still Unknown too. With the fog in hand the GM sees them anyway, to be able to click them.
map.hex_panel.exploration_activity_scout: Exploration activity: scouts the hex one is in. Roads do not shorten it.
map.hex_panel.fit_grid_image: Fit the grid to the image
map.hex_panel.ford_costs_much_that: The ford costs as much as that terrain — one activity on plains, three in a swamp — because it is the only number the rules give for that place. Here you may decide another. And remember that for a stretch to swim or climb the rules leave the GM an Athletics check once an hour.
map.hex_panel.grid_fitted_radius_px: Grid fitted: radius {size} px for {columns} columns.
map.hex_panel.grid_stops_hexes_all: The grid stops at {MAX_GRID_CELLS} hexes in all: {key} brought to {val}.
map.hex_panel.hex_fields_create_them: Hex fields — create them below, then tick here those the party has not discovered yet.
map.hex_panel.hide_from_players_again: Hide it from the players again: it goes back among the secret features, and you reveal it when they discover it
map.hex_panel.hide_from_players_again_2: Hide it from the players again
map.hex_panel.loaded_but_i_could: «{name}» loaded, but I could not read its size: enter it by hand below.
map.hex_panel.loaded_px_use_fit: «{name}» loaded ({dim}×{dim2} px). Use «Fit the grid» and then fine-tune with the sliders.
map.hex_panel.not_enough_rp_increase: Not enough RP: increase a Ruin of your choice by 1.
map.hex_panel.only_gm_can_change: Only the GM can change the map image.
map.hex_panel.png_jpg_gif_webp: PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP required.
map.hex_panel.removes_crossing_river_bec: Removes the crossing: the river becomes impassable again
map.hex_panel.requires_reconnoitered_hex: Requires a Reconnoitered hex, adjacent to the kingdom and free of threats
map.hex_panel.reveal_this_hex_single: Reveal this hex to a single player
map.hex_panel.river_crossing_hex: On the river crossing the hex
map.hex_panel.river_lake_running_between: A river or a lake running between two hexes: whoever goes on foot does not cross it without a bridge or a ford. It is not a rule of the book, it is a choice of the table — the rules speak of Water Borders only inside a settlement.
map.hex_panel.secret_features_you_reveal: Secret features — you reveal them when the party discovers them, even if the hex is already known.
map.hex_panel.settlement_detached_from_h: Settlement detached from the hex: you find it in the City tab.
map.hex_panel.this_hex_already_contains: This hex already contains a settlement.
map.hex_panel.this_hex_has_resource: This hex has a Resource feature: if the site collects that Commodity, production doubles to 2.
map.hex_panel.unexplored_territory_nothi: Unexplored territory: nothing is known about it yet.
map.hex_panel.visible_features_crossed_o: Visible features — the crossed-out eye puts them back among the secrets, without deleting them.
map.hex_panel.you_can_also_copy: You can also copy the files directly into {ASSETS} and pick them below.
map.markers.click_takes_one_ctrl: A click takes one; ctrl+click adds more than one.
map.markers.departing_single_vehicle_thi: Departing with a single vehicle: this other one taken.
map.markers.there_are_here_whom: There are {len} here: whom do you move?
map.page.gm_fog_tooltip: How thick the fog is on the GM screens: light enough to keep reading the map underneath.
map.page.hexes_still_unknown_will: The {len} hexes still «Unknown» will go back under the fog. Those already explored stay visible.
map.page.hides_hex_icons_names: Hides hex icons and names: the map stays, and so do the markers
map.page.hold_ctrl_pick_more: hold ctrl to pick more than one
map.page.hold_right_button_wheel: Hold the right button (or the wheel) on the map and drag to move around.
map.page.how_much_terrain_colours: How much the terrain colours cover the map image. At zero only the hex edges remain
map.page.players_only_your_screen: Players only: on your screen the fog stays light
map.page.puts_fog_back_every: Puts the fog back on every Unknown hex
map.page.shows_only_what_you: Shows only what you revealed to the party, without changing account
map.page.then_click_hexes_hide: Then click the hexes to hide from the players
map.page.then_click_hexes_reveal: Then click the hexes to reveal
map.page.there_are_no_active: There are no active player accounts.
map.page.these_are_revealed_whole: {len} of these are revealed to the whole party: taking them from a single player would not be enough, choose «The whole party».
map.page.you_are_seeing_players: You are seeing as the players
map.ruler.arrow_cannot_get_there: The arrow cannot get there in a single hop: from there the road exists but it is a long way around. Take it hex by hex and it follows you.
map.ruler.no_path_destination_cannot: No path: the destination cannot be reached through known hexes only.
map.ruler.no_way_through_there: No way through there: there is water between the two hexes. It takes a bridge, a ford, or a water vehicle assigned to whoever leaves.
map.travel.alone_they_would_reach: alone they would reach the destination in {alone:g} d instead of {total_days:.0f}
map.travel.any_hex_will_do: any hex will do, that one flies
map.travel.assigned_who_however_leave: «{vehicle_name}» is assigned to {names}, who however leave from different hexes: a vehicle sits in a single place.
map.travel.back_shed_whoever_was: Back in the shed. Whoever was on it stays where they were, on foot.
map.travel.bridge_over_river_crossing: The bridge over the river crossing the hex is passed
map.travel.chosen_characters_are_not: The chosen characters are not in the same hex ({where}): the journey leaves from the first one.
map.travel.click_destination_hex_map: Click the destination hex on the map.
map.travel.click_hex_where_they: Click the hex where they get off: the vehicle's or a neighbouring one. From a boat one gets off ashore, not in the middle of the lake.
map.travel.click_map_where: Click on the map where {name} is.
map.travel.click_map_where_put: Click on the map where to put it: {get}.
map.travel.click_marker_whoever_leaves: Click the marker of whoever leaves, then drag or right-click for the destination. The icon shows and hides the routes already departed.
map.travel.departed_each_their_own: Departed each on their own towards {arrival},{arrival2}: {join}
map.travel.div_style_font_size_3: {missing_ones} {v} to the finish · departed on turn {turn_created}
map.travel.estimate_most_part_path: Estimate at most: part of the path has never been explored.
map.travel.everyone_gets_there_their: Everyone gets there at their own Speed; from there one goes on together, at the slowest one's pace. Meeting here makes nobody arrive later than they would alone.
map.travel.first_choose_who_leaves: First choose who leaves: click their marker on the map or the portrait below it.
map.travel.first_sort_out_whoever: First sort out whoever is already travelling: either cancel their journey, or leave them out of this one.
map.travel.from_boat_you_choose: From a boat you choose where, and then click the hex; from a land vehicle they get off next to it
map.travel.journey_cancelled_leave_again: Journey to {arrival} cancelled to leave again
map.travel.kilometres_come_from_travel: The kilometres come from the Travel Speed table and hold on flat, clear ground: difficult terrain halves them, greater difficult cuts them to a third. Travel between hexes is counted in activities anyway, not in kilometres.
map.travel.map_click_hex_take: On the map: click a hex to take every marker on it, or a single marker to take that one. With ctrl it adds to the selection.
map.travel.must_hex_drawn_water: it must be a hex with drawn water, or inside a lake
map.travel.must_hex_some_land: it must be a hex with some land: a wagon cannot stand in a lake
map.travel.no_character_create_them: No character: create them in the Party tab.
map.travel.no_chosen_character_map: No chosen character is on the map.
map.travel.no_path_destination_cannot: No path: the destination cannot be reached through known hexes only.
map.travel.none_chosen_characters_map: None of the chosen characters is on the map: put them on a hex from the Party tab.
map.travel.not_your_character_you: Not your character: you can see it, not move it.
map.travel.off_everyone_goes_their: Off, everyone goes on their own at their own Speed: it is also the way to split the party
map.travel.one_leaves_from_where: One leaves from where the vehicle is, and the right button chooses where to arrive.
map.travel.one_more_travel_activity: One more Travel activity per day, for a number of days equal to the Constitution modifier (minimum 1)
map.travel.only_whoever_has_vehicle: Only whoever has the vehicle in front of them: in the same piece of hex, or on a shore touching the water where the boat is
map.travel.planner_stops_here_rules: The planner stops here: the rules assign no travel category to these terrains. The GM can decide it in the hex's GM Screen box.
map.travel.remove_route_from_map: Remove the route from the map
map.travel.river_crossing_hex_forded: The river crossing the hex is forded: +{inner_cost} activities
map.travel.river_cutting_hex_swum: The river cutting the hex is swum across: no bridge needed, and no extra activities
map.travel.road_one_degree_terrain: Road: one degree of terrain less
map.travel.seats_are_counted_party: {why}. Seats are counted in the Party tab
map.travel.sets_party_its_way: Sets the party on its way: it advances on its own while time passes
map.travel.skips_result_markers_arrive: Skips to the result: the markers arrive at once, without letting the days pass
map.travel.somebody_party_already_travel: Somebody in the party is already travelling: cancel their journey or leave them out of this one.
map.travel.span_class_km_chip_3: path to be decided: see the Travel box
map.travel.span_class_km_chip_4: somebody is already travelling: see the Travel box
map.travel.take_back_shed_goes: Take it back to the shed: it goes back to being just a line in Transport
map.travel.that_piece_cannot_reached: That piece of {arrival},{arrival2} cannot be reached entering from there: there is water in between and no way to pass it. The journey stops on the shore one enters from.
map.travel.there_no_meeting_point: There is no meeting point that suits everybody: everyone leaves on their own.
map.travel.they_all_leave_together: They all leave together with a single «Depart»: each at their own Speed, by their own road.
map.travel.traced_common_road_not: The traced common road is not valid: the cheapest one was made instead.
map.travel.traced_path_not_valid: The traced path is not valid: the cheapest one was made instead.
map.travel.united_party_travels_vehicle: The united party travels at the vehicle's Speed instead of its slowest member's, if there are seats for everybody. The rules do not say so: it is a choice of the table
map.travel.way_they_advance_while: On the way: they advance while time passes. You can also resolve them by hand from the Kingdom Turn tab.
map.travel.you_can_only_move: You can only move a party with one of your characters in it.
map.travel.you_do_not_have: You do not have permission to plan a journey.
map.water.away_water_there_now: Away with the water there is now, and this in its place
map.water.borders_banks_crossings_json: Borders, banks and crossings in a JSON file
map.water.borders_banks_hexes: {len} borders and the banks of {cut_ones} hexes
map.water.bridge_from_one_shore: Bridge on {coord},{coord2}: from one shore to the other one passes.
map.water.cancelled_there_no_second: Cancelled: there is no second point there sitting on the same hex as the first. The first belongs to {which_ones}: the second must be another vertex — or the center — of one of those.
map.water.cancelled_upstream_downstream_: Cancelled: upstream and downstream are the same point.
map.water.center_hex_counts_too: The center of the hex counts too: it is a point like the others. It serves to make a river turn inside a cell instead of cutting it straight — vertex, center, vertex. On its own it divides nothing, because it does not touch the edge: it is the vertices that divide.
map.water.chart_read_borders_cut: Chart read: {len} borders, {len2} cut hexes. Look at it on the map before accepting it.
map.water.click_middle_lake_wide: Click in the middle of a lake or a wide river. Two or three points are enough, and one for every different blue: the dark lake and the light line of a brook are two colours.
map.water.click_near_vertex_nearest: Click near a vertex: the nearest vertex of the grid counts, not the hex the click fell in. A vertex belongs to three hexes, and which is the right one is said by the second vertex.
map.water.click_vertices_outline_one: Click the vertices of the outline, one after the other, and go back to the first to close the shape. The first point shows bigger: it is the one to click again.
map.water.click_water_line_ford: Click the water line to ford. On the edge between two hexes it costs one more activity; on the river crossing the hex it costs as much as that terrain — you can change the difficulty from the hex's sheet.
map.water.click_water_line_hop: {BORDER_NAMES}: click the water line to hop over — a stretch inside the hex, or a wet side between two hexes.
map.water.click_water_line_hop_2: Click the water line to hop over: a stretch inside the hex, or a wet side between two hexes. The bridge is placed there, and from one shore to the other one passes at no cost. The river must already be there: a bridge hops over something.
map.water.direction_eraser_click_stretch: Direction eraser on: click the stretches to remove the direction from, one after the other. The lines all stay.
map.water.direction_removed_that_stretch: Direction removed: that stretch goes back to water without a current, travelled both ways the same. The line stays.
map.water.directions_removed_rivers_stay: Directions removed: {how_many}. The rivers stay where they are.
map.water.draws_rivers_fords_bridges: Draws rivers, fords and bridges on the sides between hexes. The icon shows and hides those already marked.
map.water.entries_discarded_malformed_he: {discarded} entries discarded: malformed, or on hexes this grid does not have.
map.water.erased_water_borders_banks: Erased {how_many} water borders, the banks of {len} hexes and {removed_items} bridges
map.water.eraser_hold_down_pass: Eraser: hold down and pass over the lines to remove. The one you pass over vanishes — a border or a cut, no matter. A single click removes the line under the pointer.
map.water.every_click_removes_direction: Every click removes the direction from the stretch under the pointer; the line stays. Press it again to go back to marking them.
map.water.file_every_river_drawn: A file with every river drawn on this map: it is kept aside as a copy, and sent to another table playing on the same map. Inside there is the grid calibration too, because a border is a pair of coordinates and coordinates mean something only relative to a grid.
map.water.file_too_large_water: File too large: a water chart fits in {v} MB with room to spare.
map.water.first_pick_water_colour: First pick the water colour: without it, I cannot tell it from land and I do not try to guess.
map.water.first_pick_water_colour_2: First pick the water colour: click the blue of the drawing.
map.water.first_point_lake_follow: First point of the lake. Follow the outline vertex by vertex, and come back here to close.
map.water.first_vertex_taken_click: First vertex taken. Click the second: which hex you are working on is said by the two vertices together, and it is the one that has them both —
map.water.ford_river_crossing_one: Ford on the river crossing {coord},{coord2}: one passes, and it costs as much as that terrain. You can change the difficulty from the hex's sheet.
map.water.from_there_there_one: From there to there one cannot go down along the water: the two points are on two different watercourses, or a stretch is missing in between.
map.water.hexes_are_crossed_watercourse: {cut_ones} hexes are crossed by a watercourse cutting them in two: one enters from every side, but from one bank one does not pass to the other.
map.water.hexes_share_second_will: ({how_many} hexes share it: the second will say which)
map.water.hexes_terrains_are_not: Hexes and terrains are not touched.
map.water.if_you_only_want: If you only want to redo the automatic reading there is no need to erase: «Read the map» replaces on its own what it had found and leaves the rest alone.
map.water.including_you_marked_hand: , including the {by_hand} you marked by hand.
map.water.inside_lake_there_no: Inside a lake there is no current to follow or go up: there is no direction, one sails where one wants — open terrain, as the rules say of whoever travels on water — and leaves where the lake touches a river.
map.water.join_two_points_same: Join two points of the same hex: where the water enters and where it leaves. If they are neighbouring vertices the edge between two hexes comes out; if they are far apart, a river crossing the hex and cutting it into two shores — and from one shore to the other one does not pass. A second stretch adds to the first, and the Eraser removes one at a time.
map.water.keeps_what_there_lays: Keeps what is there and lays the chart on top
map.water.lake_closed_points_inside: Lake closed: {len} points, {n_items} {v} inside. There the water is still, one sails where one wants and leaves where it touches a river.
map.water.lake_names_tooltip: Show or hide the names of the lakes on the map, in this window only.
map.water.lake_removed_lines_stay: Lake removed. The lines stay where they were.
map.water.least_three_points_are: At least three points are needed to close a shape.
map.water.map_you_see_b: On the map you see it in orange, on top of what is already there.
map.water.marked_body_water: Marked a body of water of {n_items} {v}
map.water.middle_hex_does_not: On {where} {n_items} in the middle of the hex: it does not touch the edge, so one enters it only with a bridge or a ford.
map.water.needed_because_rules_make: It is needed because the rules make the effort depend on it: going down a river is open terrain, going up is difficult or greater difficult depending on currents and weather. A stretch without a direction is not an error: it is water without a current, travelled both ways the same and counting as open terrain — as all the water of a lake is.
map.water.no_longer_filled_flooding: It is no longer filled by flooding, and the reason is good: a hand-drawn lake does not follow the hex edges — it cuts where the water cuts — so the ring of lines almost never closes. You give it the shape.
map.water.no_watercourse_passes_there: No watercourse passes there. Click a vertex of the river.
map.water.not_rule_book_rules: It is not a rule of the book: the rules speak of Water Borders only inside a settlement. It is a choice of the table.
map.water.pick_brush_water_you: Pick a brush: with Water you draw the river, with Bridge and Ford you pass over it, with Current you say which way it flows, with Lake you fill an enclosed body of water, and with the Eraser you remove.
map.water.proposal_accepted_what_was: Proposal accepted; what was marked by hand was not touched.
map.water.proposal_lakes_html: On the map you see them in orange. Look at them before accepting: snowy peaks are pale and bluish like water, and now and then they end up in the list.
map.water.read_from_image_water: Read from the image {how_many} water borders and the banks of {cut_ones} hexes
map.water.remove_single_one_there: To remove a single one there is «Remove a direction» below: switch it on and every click removes the direction from the stretch under it, leaving the line where it is. With ctrl held the click does the same without switching anything on. It is the way to correct a wrong direction without redoing the river.
map.water.river_does_not_sit: A river does not sit inside a hex: it sits between two. Here you mark the sides the water crosses, and whoever goes on foot does not pass them without a bridge or a ford.
map.water.shape_contains_center_no: The shape contains the center of no hex: widen it, or travel would have nowhere to pass.
map.water.shores_are_count_holds: On {where} the shores are {len}: the count holds, but the hex becomes hard to read at a glance. If you do not need all this precision, the Eraser removes one stretch at a time.
map.water.sides_fall_outside_image: {outside_image} sides fall outside the image and were not read: they are not land, they are unread.
map.water.stretch_marked_but_its: On {where} the stretch is marked, but on its own it does not divide the hex: draw it to another vertex of the edge, and from one shore to the other one will no longer pass.
map.water.stretch_was_added_those: (the stretch was added to those already there).
map.water.switching_them_off_travel: Switching them off travel goes back as it was: no river stops it, and the Lake and River terrains do not count
map.water.that_point_already_there: That point is already there. Go back to the first one to close the shape.
map.water.that_side_outside_map: That side is outside the map.
map.water.that_stretch_already_there: On {coord},{coord2} that stretch is already there.
map.water.there_no_direction_remove: There is no direction to remove.
map.water.there_no_grid_point: There is no grid point there.
map.water.there_no_stretch_marked: There is no stretch with a marked direction there.
map.water.there_no_watercourse_drawn: There is no watercourse drawn yet: first the river with the Water brush, then the direction.
map.water.this_lake_one_old: This lake is one of the old ones, filled by flooding: it has no outline to edit. Redraw it point by point and it will replace this one.
map.water.turned_other_way_from: , {turned} turned the other way from how it was.
map.water.turned_other_way_from_2: , {turned} turned the other way from how they were.
map.water.upstream_point_taken_now: Upstream point taken. Now click where the water arrives: the direction goes from here to there.
map.water.upstream_taken_move_mouse: Upstream taken. Move the mouse along the river and click where the water arrives. To start over, click the same point twice.
map.water.water_borders_are_off: The water borders are off. Travel looks neither at rivers nor at banks, and the Lake and River terrains stop nobody any more: it is up to the Game Master to tell the table that river cannot be forded.
map.water.water_chart_borders_cut: Water chart {v}: {borders} borders, {banks} cut hexes, {crossings} crossings, {currents} stretches with a direction
map.water.what_you_already_marked: What you already marked stays where it is and comes back when you switch them on again.
map.water.which_way_water_flows: Which way the water flows. Click the upstream vertex, then follow the river with the mouse — the guide shows you the course — and click where the water arrives. Every stretch in between takes the direction, from upstream to downstream.
party.border_token_map: The border of the token on the map
party.empty_fields_remove_token: Empty the fields to remove the token from the map.
party.extra_metres_from_feats: Extra Speed from feats, items or spells. Kept apart to see where the total comes from.
party.hex_exploration_table_ft: Hexploration table: up to 10 ft ½, 15–25 ft 1, 30–40 ft 2, 45–55 ft 3, 60 ft or more 4.
party.hex_exploration_table_m: Hex Exploration table: up to 3 m ½, 4.5–7.5 m 1, 9–12 m 2, 13.5–16.5 m 3, 18 m or more 4.
party.holds_those_roles_will: Holds: {names}. Those roles will be left vacant.
party.how_many_days_forced: How many days of forced march they withstand before becoming Fatigued
party.leave_zero_if_they: Leave it at zero if they have none. It serves to pass water: the rules put the Swim Speed next to the vehicle as a second way of crossing.
party.name: Name
party.no_character_linked_your: No character linked to your account.
party.only_game_master_can: Only the Game Master can create characters.
party.only_game_master_can_2: Only the Game Master can delete a character.
party.only_vehicles_placed_their: Only the vehicles placed in their own hex. They are put on the map from Travel, and the rest is done there
party.png_jpg_gif_webp: PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP required.
party.portrait_token_are_yours: Portrait and token are yours: the token is what appears on the map, on the hex where the character is.
party.speed_character_sheet: The Speed on the character sheet
party.swims_passes_water_border: Swims at {format_metres}: passes a Water Border and enters a water hex without a boat. For the party to cross, though, everybody must swim — one goes as the slowest, and whoever cannot swim stays ashore.
party.vehicle_if_one_front: Vehicle, if one is in front of them
party.who_sees_edits_this: Who sees and edits this sheet, besides the Game Master
party.will_removed_from_campaign: «{name}» will be removed from the campaign.
party.you_see_sheet_characters: You see the sheet of the characters linked to your account. The Game Master makes the link.
permissions.role_description.admin: Everything, plus account management and the save file.
permissions.role_description.gm: Prepares the map, knows the secrets, decides what has been revealed.
permissions.role_description.player: Plays: activities, turn, city, the hexes they know.
rules.resource_die_gain: Roll {n} Resource Dice and gain the RP
rules.resource_die_spend: Roll {n} Resource Dice and spend the RP
sheet.character_may_hold_several: A character may hold several leadership roles: they count as a single person for Leadership Activities.
sheet.consumption_settlements_armies_inf: Consumption = settlements {settlements} + armies {armies} − influenced farmlands {farms} + events {events} = {total}
sheet.days_forced_march_they: Days of forced march they withstand
sheet.distinct_pc_leaders_they: Distinct PC leaders: {leader_pc} — they decide how many Leadership Activities you may attempt in a turn.
sheet.favored_terrain_once_per: Favored Terrain: {name} — once per turn you may attempt two Region Activities together in the same hex with this terrain, with −2 to the checks.
sheet.feats_owned_about_expected: Feats owned: {len} (about {expected} expected: 1 bonus from the government + 1 every 2 levels from the 2nd)
sheet.holds_those_roles_will: Holds: {names}. Those roles will be left vacant.
sheet.invested_4_invested_role: Invested: {n_inv}/4 — an invested role grants +{role_status_bonus} status to checks based on its key ability.
sheet.kingdom_level_4_bonus: Kingdom level + 4 + bonus dice − penalty dice
sheet.name: Name
sheet.only_gm_can_manage: Only the GM can manage characters.
sheet.resource_points_current_turn: Resource Points of the current turn. Unspent RP become XP at the end of the turn.
sheet.span_class_km_chip_3: {pen} status to all checks
sheet.span_class_km_chip_4: ANARCHY — only Quell Unrest, all checks worsened by one degree
sheet.ticked_player_plays_them: Ticked: a player plays them. Otherwise it is an NPC.
sheet.used_compute_journeys_map: Used to compute journeys on the map
sheet.when_points_ruin_exceed: When the points of a Ruin exceed its threshold, reduce the points by the threshold and increase the penalty by 1.
sheet.will_removed_from_campaign: «{name}» will be removed from the campaign.
state.activities_used_up_this: {name} activities used up for this turn ({max}/{max2}).
state.kingdom_anarchy_only_quell: The kingdom is in Anarchy: only Quell Unrest is available.
state.kingdom_not_any_required: The kingdom is not {name} in any of the required skills.
theme.natural_1_result_worsened: Natural 1: result worsened by one degree.
theme.natural_20_result_improved: Natural 20: result improved by one degree.
theme.you_do_not_have: You do not have permission for this action.
transport.aboard_link_from_before: aboard: a link from before, when a vehicle had no position. Place it and it becomes true again, or they get off from their sheet.
transport.chosen_table_rules_give: Chosen by the table: {name}. The rules give it as {get}.
transport.depot_explain.air: They fly. For the journey water does not stop them — «If you're flying or traveling on water, most hexes are open terrain» — but a river is not a road for them: they pass over it, not along it.
transport.depot_explain.land: They go by land. They stop in front of a Water Border like whoever goes on foot: to pass it takes a bridge, a ford, or a boat.
transport.depot_explain.water: They go by water. They cross Water Borders and lake hexes, and are the only ones that can follow the course of a river drawn on the map.
transport.disappears_from_stable_whoever: «{label}» disappears from the stable. Whoever was on it goes back on foot.
transport.from_rules_catalogue_speed: From the rules catalogue: {name}, for the Speed it has written.
transport.leave_empty_use_catalogue: Leave empty to use the catalogue's
transport.no_boat_without_one: No boat: without one, a river remains a wall.
transport.png_jpg_gif_webp: PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP required.
transport.remove_vehicle_from_stable: Remove the vehicle from the stable?
transport.rules_give_no_speed: The rules give it no Speed, so they do not say where it goes either: you choose that.
transport.seats_but_assigned_characters: It seats {seats} ({why}), but the assigned characters are {how_many}.
transport.seats_counted_until_there: Seats to be counted: {why_seats}. Until there is a number the party cannot travel aboard.
transport.shed_not_map_so: In the shed: it is not on the map, so nobody can board it. Put it on a hex from Map → Travel.
transport.token_appears_map_hex: The token appears on the map in the hex where you placed the vehicle.
transport.untick_when_vehicle_broken: Untick it when the vehicle is broken, lent or far away
transport.vehicle_data_from_rules: Vehicle data from the rules. When the rules give no Speed figure — a wagon goes as fast as the creature towing it — you write it here: the app does not make it up.
transport.vehicles_kingdom_owns_whoever: The vehicles the kingdom owns. Whoever has one assigned travels at its Speed instead of on foot.
transport.who_boards_who_gets: Who boards and who gets off is decided on the map, in Travel: one boards a vehicle in front of them, and gets off declaring where they set foot.
transport.you_do_not_have: You do not have permission for the stable.
travel.against_current_rules_give: against the current: the rules give them as difficult or greater difficult terrain depending on currents and weather. Here they count as difficult.
travel.are_but_two_different: {v} and «{name}» are on {its_own},{its_own2} but in two different pieces of the hex: one boards a vehicle in front of them, in the same piece.
travel.category_chosen_table_not: : category chosen by the table, not by the rules
travel.edge_note: The party travels aboard: the activities per day come from the vehicle's Speed, and the passengers move with it. Hex Exploration does not speak of vehicles: it is a choice of the table, not a written rule.
travel.everybody_has_swim_speed: everybody has a Swim Speed, the slowest is {slowest:g} m
travel.forced_march_travel_activities: Forced march: +{extra_activities} Travel activities per day. It holds for {sustainable} {v} ({sustainable_days}); beyond: {beyond}
travel.forced_march_travel_activities_2: Forced march: +{extra_activities} Travel activities per day. It holds for {sustainable} {v}.
travel.from_one_does_not: From {where},{where2} one does not get off on {coord},{coord2}: one sets foot where the vehicle is or in a neighbouring hex.
travel.from_one_gets_off: From «{name}» one gets off ashore, on a shore touching the water where it is stopped: that piece of {coord},{coord2} does not touch it.
travel.from_page_passengers_pilot: from the page: {passengers} passengers and the pilot
travel.has_no_speed_metres: {name}: «{label}» has no Speed figure ({reason}). For now they count as on foot.
travel.has_no_speed_metres_2: «{label}» has no Speed figure ({reason}): it cannot be used for the party.
travel.hex_border_party_has: Hex {col},{row}: {border_name} on the border, and the party has no water vehicle to pass it.
travel.hex_departing_fording_river: Hex {coord},{coord2}: departing by fording the river crossing it, +{cost_inside} activities.
travel.hex_moving_from_one: Hex {coord},{coord2}: moving from one shore to the other without leaving it, {quarters} activities.
travel.hex_now_counts: Hex {col},{row}: {reason}. For now it counts as {name}.
travel.hex_river_crossing_forded: Hex {col},{row}: the river crossing it is forded, +{quarters} activities. If the stretch is to be swum or climbed, the rules leave the GM a check (Athletics) once an hour.
travel.hex_river_crossing_forded_2: Hex {col},{row}: the river crossing it is forded, +{inner_cost} activities. If the stretch is to be swum or climbed, the rules leave the GM a check (Athletics) once an hour.
travel.hex_water_forces_one: Hex {col},{row}: the water forces one to hug the shore instead of cutting straight, +{quarters} activities.
travel.journey_lasts_days_more: The journey lasts {days} days, more than the {sustainable} sustainable: whoever undertakes it ends up Fatigued.
travel.m_no_faster_than: «{label}» ({how_much}) is no faster than the party as it is now: boarding it changes nothing.
travel.marked_direction_water_without: marked direction: water without a current, travelled both ways the same and counting as open terrain. Marking the current with the brush does not shorten it: it makes going up dearer.
travel.marked_unavailable_stable_so: {name}: «{label}» is marked unavailable in the stable, so they go on foot.
travel.never_explored_hex_counted: never explored hex: counted at the maximum cost
travel.no_speed_fill_sheet: No Speed: fill in the sheet of whoever leaves, or choose a vehicle.
travel.none_travellers_brings_along: none of the travellers brings along a water or flying vehicle
travel.none_travellers_brings_along_2: None of the travellers brings along a vehicle: the party goes on foot.
travel.not_available_stable_nobody: «{label}» is not available in the stable: nobody boards it.
travel.not_everybody_can_swim: not everybody can swim across — {why_swim} — and the party is not aboard any vehicle
travel.not_known_how_many: «{label}»: it is not known how many people fit ({why}). Until you decide, the party goes on foot.
travel.not_known_how_many_2: «{label}»: it is not known how many people fit ({why})
travel.not_map_put_hex: «{name}» is not on the map: put it in a hex first, and then one boards it.
travel.not_map_there_nowhere: «{name}» is not on the map: there is nowhere to get off from.
travel.not_map_yet_they: {v} is not on the map yet: they cannot board anything.
travel.not_shore_touching_point: {v} is not on a shore touching the point where «{name}» is stopped: one boards from a bank touching the water where the boat is.
travel.one_boards_vehicle_front: {v} is on {its_own},{its_own2} and «{name}» on {where},{where2}: one boards a vehicle in front of them, not a far one.
travel.page_does_not_say: the page does not say how many passengers it carries
travel.page_no_speed_metres: the page does not give the Speed as a figure
travel.page_says_speed_pilot: the page says «the Speed of the pilot»
travel.page_says_speed_slowest: the page says «the Speed of the slowest towing creature»: enter the draft animal's
travel.page_writes_count_seats: the page writes «{passengers}»: count the seats by hand
travel.party_aboard_water_vehicle: the party is aboard a water vehicle
travel.party_not_aboard_cross: the party is not aboard: to cross the water everybody must board the vehicle, or everybody must have a Swim Speed
travel.path_counted_worst_cost: {how_many} {hexes} of the path {explored}: counted at the worst cost ({unknown_cost} activities each, {lower}). The real journey can only be shorter than this.
travel.rules_assign_no_travel: the rules assign no travel category to
travel.rules_give_difficult_greater: : the rules give it as difficult or greater difficult
travel.seats_are_not_enough: The seats are not enough: {total_seats} for {len} travellers. Whoever fits boards, but the united party goes like whoever stays on foot.
travel.seats_water_vehicle_are: the seats on the water vehicle are not enough: {seats} for {len} travellers
travel.still_water_lake_there: still water: in the lake there is no current, one sails where one wants and it counts as open terrain.
travel.still_water_one_goes: still water: one goes where one wants, and whoever sails finds open terrain
travel.this_speed_more_than: At this Speed more than a day is needed for every activity: the party does not even cross one open hex in a day.
travel.vehicle_note: The activities per day come from the vehicle's Speed. Hex Exploration does not say so explicitly: it is a choice of the table, not a written rule.
travel.water_vehicle_needed_pass: {names}: a water vehicle is needed to pass
travel.water_vehicle_not_available: the water vehicle is not available in the stable
turn.1d10_ruin_points_distribute: 1d10 = {tot} Ruin points to distribute among the four Ruins.
turn.assign_change_leaders_from: Assign or change the leaders from the kingdom sheet. Mark «Vacant» whoever did not spend the required week of Downtime.
turn.build_structure_performed_from: Build a Structure is performed from the City section.
turn.claim_hex_max_times: Claim Hex: max {claims_per_turn} times at this level. Hex actions are performed from the Map section.
turn.click_number_type: click the number to type it
turn.confirm_requirements_able_roll: Confirm the requirements to be able to roll.
turn.current_dc_back_16: Current DC: {event_dc} (back to 16 after an event, −5 after every turn without events)
turn.div_class_km_chip: ANARCHY: only Quell Unrest, all checks worsened by one degree.
turn.every_pc_leader_may: Every PC leader may attempt up to {max_leadership_activities} Leadership activities (3 if the capital has a Castle, Palace or Town Hall).
turn.flat_check_dc_11: Flat Check DC 11 (loss of a hex)
turn.gm_rolls_events_table: The GM rolls on the events table. The kingdom gains 30 XP for facing it, whatever the outcome.
turn.kingdom_has_xp_but: The kingdom has the XP but is already at the party's level: the maximum level is the PCs'.
turn.kingdom_loses_hex_pcs: The kingdom loses a hex: the PCs choose which. Abandon it from the map.
turn.moves_markers_arrival_hex: Moves the markers to the arrival hex
turn.no_active_work_site: No active Work Site in the claimed hexes.
turn.no_automatic_effect_adjust: No automatic effect: adjust by hand what is needed.
turn.not_enough_food_pay: Not enough Food ({food}/{cons}). Pay the difference in RP or accept the Unrest.
turn.not_enough_rp_increase: Not enough RP: increase a Ruin of your choice by 1.
turn.only_counter_changes_does: Only the counter changes: it does not undo what already happened, does not touch RP, Fame or attempted activities, and does not move the campaign date (that is corrected from the clock at the top).
turn.planned_map_resolve_them: Planned on the map. Resolve them when the party arrives: the markers move only then.
turn.resolve_events_here_use: Resolve the events here: use the sheet to roll the needed checks and the quick adjustments to apply their effects. The DC of an event is the Control DC ({control_dc}) modified by the event's level.
turn.start_every_turn_you: At the start of every turn you gain 1 {v} point; points unspent at the end of the turn are lost.
turn.this_activity_performed_from: This activity is performed from the Map tab: open the target hex and use the buttons of the actions panel. There the check applies the RP cost and the result on the map by itself.
turn.this_activity_performed_from_2: This activity is performed from the City tab: choose the settlement and the lots. There the check applies the RP and Commodities cost by itself.
turn.untick_what_does_not: Untick what does not apply at the table; the values can be edited.
turn.you_can_only_cancel: You can only cancel a journey with one of your characters in it.
turn.you_can_only_resolve: You can only resolve a journey with one of your characters in it.
water_chart.chart_drawn_grid_orientation: The chart is drawn on a grid with «{orientation}» orientation, this map is «{get}». The side directions would not mean the same thing.
water_chart.chart_grid_this_one: The chart is for a grid of {its} {how}, this one has {get}: whatever falls outside is lost.
water_chart.chart_version_this_app: The chart is version {version} and this app reaches {VERSION}: update the app.
water_chart.drawn_another_image_coordina: Drawn on another image ({image}). The coordinates stay the same, but check that the rivers land where they should.
water_chart.file_not_readable_json: The file is not readable JSON.
water_chart.not_text_file_water: Not a text file: water charts are JSON files.
water_chart.same_image_but_grid: Same image but the grid is calibrated differently: the rivers will land on the same hexes, not necessarily on the same drawing.
water_chart.this_not_kingmaker_water: This is not a Kingmaker water chart.
water_reading.i_do_not_know: I do not know what colour the water is on this map. Use «Pick the water colour» and click two or three points on the blue of the drawing: the colour comes from there, not from a table.
water_reading.pillow_library_needed_open: The Pillow library, needed to open the image, is missing. The app works anyway: borders are marked by hand.
water_reading.points_you_pointed_have: The points you pointed at have the same colour as the rest of the map: whatever I read would be noise, not water. Try again clicking in the middle of the blue of a lake or a wide river, away from edges and lettering.
